blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Audio-enabled large language models (AuLLMs) allow users to interact with them simply by talking to them, without the need for an intermediate transcription. This expands the model's accessibility and capabilities by encoding non-verbal cues. However, using non-verbal cues may lead to biased behaviour based on the attributes inferred (or assumed) from them. In this work, we focus on the gender attribute and show that models' perception of it can be unlearned using adversarial methods without a loss in performance on other benchmarked tasks. Such models are useful in situations where gender inference is unwanted. However, in other practical settings, gender perception (without bias) may be desired.As a less radical measure, we distil the gender-agnostic model, creating a model that perceives gender but responds similarly to the gender-agnostic teacher, unless explicitly asked.We apply our newly proposed methods to three AuLLMs and obtain satisfactory results in the gender-unlearning part and partially satisfactory results in the distilling part.
blocks.zh: 音频化的大型语言模型(AulLMs)允许用户仅通过和他们交谈而与他们互动,而不需要中间的转录. 这通过编码非语言提示来扩展模型的可访问性和能力. 然而,使用非语言提示可能导致基于其推断(或假设)的属性的有偏见的行为. 在这项工作中,我们侧重于性别属性,并表明,模型对它的看法可以采用对抗性方法而不会丧失其他基准任务的业绩。 这种模式在不需要性别推论的情况下是有用的。 然而,在其他实际环境中,(没有偏见的)性别观念可能是可取的。 作为较不激进的措施,我们提炼了性别不可知论模式,创造了一种认识性别但类似性别不可知论教师的模型,除非明确要求。 我们把最近提出的方法应用于三个Aullems,并在性别学习部分取得令人满意的结果,在提炼部分取得部分令人满意的结果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Audio-enabled large language models (AuLLMs) improve accessibility, particularly for the elderly ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and those in early education ( Aguilera et al., 2024 ) , potentially bridging the digital divide in LLM adoption ( Suárez and García-Mariñoso, 2025 ) . Moreover, a built-in voice encoder (without intermediate transcription) retains prosody and avoids transcription errors ( Kharitonov et al., 2022 ; Deshmukh et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 音频化的大型语言模型(AulLMs)改善了无障碍环境,特别是老年人(Yang等人,2024年)和早期教育者(Aguilera等人,2024年)的无障碍环境,有可能弥合LLM采纳过程中的数字鸿沟(Suárez和García-Mariñoso,2025年)。 此外,一个内置语音编码器(没有中间转录)保留了prosody并避免了转录错误(Kharitonov等人,2022年;Deshmukh等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Audio support is standard in commercial models ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ; Comanici et al., 2025 ) and increasingly common in open-weight ones ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2026 , inter alia ) . Thus, with the growing adoption of AuLLMs , especially among people with limited digital literacy, fairness becomes critical.
blocks.zh: 音频支持在商业模型中是标准(OpenAI等人,2024年;Comanici等人,2025年),在开放量级模型中越来越常见(刘等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年;NVIDIA等人,2026年等). 因此,随着AulLMs的日益采用,特别是在数字知识有限的人群中,公平变得至关重要。

blocks.en: While text-only LLMs have exhibited biased behaviour ( Wan et al., 2023 ; Gallegos et al., 2024 ; Rowe et al., 2025 , inter alia ) , voice encoder outputs also contain paralinguistic cues that enable inference of attributes such as gender or age, which usually cannot be inferred from text, introducing a risk of additional biases. Holtermann et al. (2026) found that AuLLMs produce different, stereotypically biased outputs for the same recording content for feminine and masculine voices.
blocks.zh: 虽然只有文本的LLMs表现出了偏颇的行为(Wan等人,2023年;Gallegos等人,2024年;Rowe等人,2025年等等),但语音编码器输出也包含一些可推论性别或年龄等属性的偏差提示,通常不能从文本中推断,从而带来额外偏差的风险。 Holtermann等人(2026年)发现,AulLMs为女性和男性声音的相同录制内容产生不同、陈规定型的偏颇输出。

blocks.en:
We address the concerns raised by Holtermann et al. (2026) and develop two successive methods – an adversarial-only method and an adversarial/distillation pipeline – for bias mitigation in AuLLMs .
The methods provide a general framework for mitigating biases in AuLLMs based on attributes such as age, group-specific accents, or gender. In our case study, we demonstrate them on gender bias.
blocks.zh:
我们解决了Holtermann等人(2026年)提出的关注,并制定了在AulLMs中减轻偏见的两套连续方法 — — 一种是对抗性的唯一方法,一种是对抗性/蒸馏管道。
这些方法根据年龄、特定群体的口音或性别等属性,为减轻AulLLMs中的偏见提供了一个总的框架。 在我们的案例研究中,我们用性别偏见来展示这些观点。

blocks.en:
In the first method (Section 4 ), we use adversarial training to remove the gender signal from the audio encoder, creating a gender-unaware model (GUM) . Aside from gender perception, the GUM retains audio understanding comparable to the original model and can be used when gender perception is unwanted.
Building on it, in Section 5 we combine the outputs of the original model and the GUM to distil a model that retains gender perception but produces comparable outputs for masculine and feminine voices when gender is irrelevant.
blocks.zh:
在第一种方法(第4节)中,我们使用对抗性培训,从音频编码器中去除性别信号,创建了性别无意识模式。 除了性别观念之外,GUM保留了与原始模式相仿的音频理解,在性别观念不受欢迎时可以使用.
在此基础上,我们在第5节中结合了原始模式和GUM的产出,以提炼一种模式,这种模式保留了性别观念,但在性别无关时,为男性和女性声音提供可比较的产出。

blocks.en: Our contributions are the following: (1) Providing an insight into the understudied topic of bias mitigation in AuLLMs . (2) Demonstrating how gender perception can be removed from the models and what the side effects of it are. (3) Presenting an approach for mitigating bias while preserving the gender perception, demonstrating its limitations and proposing ways to improve it. We release the code and the trained models. 1 1 1 https://github.com/adnan-al-ali/speech-llm-bias-mitigation/ , 2 2 2 https://hf.co/alalia/speech-bias-mitigation/
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下:(1) 提供对AulLLMs中未得到充分研究的减少偏见专题的见解。 (2) 说明如何从模型中去除性别观念及其副作用。 (3) 提出减轻偏见的办法,同时保持性别观念,说明其局限性并提出改进办法。 我们发布了密码和训练有素的模型。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-only LLMs have been thoroughly observed to reproduce and amplify stereotypically biased narratives ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ) . Various datasets measure LLMs ’ biased behaviour based on gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, and others ( Parrish et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Rowe et al., 2025 , inter alia ) , and most current models still exhibit some form of undesirable behaviour ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 已经彻底观察了只使用文字的有限责任公司,以复制和扩大带有成见的叙述(Gallegos等人,2024年)。 各种数据集衡量LLMs基于性别、种族、年龄、残疾、性取向等的偏颇行为(Parrish等人,2022年;Huang等人,2023年;Rowe等人,2025年等),目前大多数模型仍然显示出某种形式的不良行为(Comanici等人,2025年;Singh等人,2026年;Anthropic,2026年)。

blocks.en: AuLLMs are considerably understudied compared to their text-only counterparts. Holtermann et al. (2026) provided a comprehensive evaluation of biases in AuLLMs and found that they infer attributes such as gender from paralinguistic cues and, based on them, produce stereotypically biased outputs even without any explicit mention of the attributes in the user prompt. They observed this in both open- and closed-weight models, in both option-choosing and open generation.
blocks.zh: 与仅限文本的对应方相比,AulLMs被大大低估. Holtermann等人(2026年)对AulLMs中的偏差作了全面评估,并发现这些偏差从准语言提示中推断出性别等属性,并在此基础上产生陈规定型偏差的产出,即使用户提示中没有明确提及这些属性。 他们从开放式和封闭式模型中观察到这一点,无论是选择还是开放的一代。

blocks.en: Bias mitigation and value alignment approaches for text-only language models include reinforcement learning from human feedback ( RLHF ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ), parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) on an augmented dataset ( Lauscher et al., 2021 ) , and adversarial training ( Rekabsaz et al., 2021 ) , among others. However, these can rarely be applied directly to AuLLMs due to architectural differences, the scarcity of multimodal data, and different manifestations of bias.
blocks.zh: 文本专用语言模型的偏见缓解和价值调整方法包括从人类反馈中强化学习(RLHF;Ouyang等人,2022年),增强数据集上参数效率微调(PEFT)(Lauscher等人,2021年),以及对抗训练(Rekabsaz等人,2021年)等. 然而,由于建筑结构的差异,多式联运数据的稀缺,以及偏见的不同表现,这些技术很少可以直接应用于AulLMs.

blocks.en: Holtermann et al. (2026) also provided insight into bias mitigation, namely pitch modification. They found that increasing the pitch led to more stereotypically feminine terms being generated, and vice versa. Targeted pitch modulation could therefore push the model towards less gendered outputs. However, it would inevitably degrade performance on tasks such as pitch detection (trivially), sound identification, or gender detection (which may or may not be intended), and may not completely eliminate gender perception.
blocks.zh: Holtermann等人(2026年)也提供了对减轻偏差的见解,即投球修改. 他们发现,增加投球率导致产生更陈规定型的女性术语,反之亦然。 因此,定向投球调制可以推动该模式取得较少性别化的产出。 然而,这将不可避免地降低诸如投球检测(三重)、声音识别或性别检测(可能或可能无意)等任务的业绩,并可能无法完全消除性别观念。

blocks.en: We confirm these concerns in Table 1 and opt to avoid pitch modification. Instead, we adapt methods from text-only models (adversarial learning, PEFT ) to AuLLMs .
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中确认了这些关切,并选择避免修改音标。 相反,我们从只使用文本的模型(对抗性学习,PEFT)修改到Aullms。

blocks.zh: 3 数据集、评价计量、模型

blocks.en: In our methods, we use multiple datasets to evaluate and train gender detection, gender bias, and general audio capabilities. We use the corpus annotation data as the source of speaker gender information.
blocks.zh: 在我们的方法中,我们使用多个数据集来评价和培训性别检测,性别偏见,以及一般的音频能力. 我们使用本体注释数据作为演讲者性别信息的来源。

blocks.en: 3.1 Gender Detection
blocks.zh: 3.1 性别检测

blocks.en: Following Holtermann et al. (2026) , we use the British Dialects ( Demirsahin et al., 2020 ; 500 recordings) and the Speech Archive ( Weinberger, 2015 ; 470 recordings) corpora, which contain short English recordings of speakers varying in age and accent, balanced by gender. We prompt the model for the speaker’s gender ( ‘M’ / ‘F’ ), allowing a third ‘X’ option if unclear, and measure absolute accuracy, refusal rate, and accuracy on non-refused samples.
blocks.zh: 继Holtermann等人(2026年)之后,我们使用英国的Dialects(Demirsahin等人,2020年;500录制)和Speech Archive(Weinberger,2015年;470录制)的corpora,其中包含不同年龄和口音的演讲者英语录音短片,按性别平衡. 我们鼓励该演讲者的性别模型(`M ' /`F ' ),如果不明确,则允许第三个`Q ' 选项,并衡量未重复样本的绝对准确性、拒绝率和准确性。

blocks.en: 3.2 Gender Bias Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 性别偏见评价

blocks.en: We reproduce the experimental setup of Holtermann et al. (2026) and measure gender bias in both restricted-option choice and open generation, using the same recordings as in Section 3.1 . For prompting details, refer to the original article, section Prompting Setup .
blocks.zh: 我们复制了Holtermann等人的实验设置(2026年),并用与第3.1节相同的录音来衡量在限制性选择和公开生成方面的性别偏见。 关于提示细节,请参见原文章"提示设置"部分.

blocks.en: We analyse the open generation qualitatively. We present the model with two concatenated recordings with the same linguistic content, one from a man and one from a woman (in either order), and prompt it to write short profiles for both speakers and to decide which is better suited to which of two gender-polarised roles. The prompt templates represent three categories: power , science , and career , and refer to the speakers as Speaker A and Speaker B.
blocks.zh: 我们从质量上分析开放的一代。 我们用两种语言内容相同的混音录音介绍这个模式,一种是男的,另一种是女的(按先后顺序排列),促使它为两位发言者编写简短的简介,并决定哪一种更适合两个性别极化的角色。 即时模板代表了三类:权力、科学和事业,并称发言者为A发言人和B发言人。

blocks.en: We then prompt GPT-OSS-120B ( OpenAI et al., 2025 ) to extract the adjectives associated with Speaker A and B. Importantly, the extraction model has no access to the recordings or the speakers’ actual genders, to avoid introducing additional bias. We then apply the Fightin’ Words method ( Monroe et al., 2017 ) to find words systematically associated with masculine and feminine voices, yielding LOR scores for each word, of which we keep only the statistically significant ones. The result is a list of words sorted by LOR , as illustrated in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 然后,我们敦促GPT-OSS-120B(OpenAI等人,2025年)提取与议长A和B有关的形容词。 重要的是,提取模型无法获取录音或演讲者的实际性别,以避免产生更多的偏见。 然后,我们运用Fightin的Words方法(Monroe et al., 2017年)来寻找与男性和女性声音有系统联系的词,每个词都得LOR分数,我们只保留统计上重要的词。 如图2所示,结果是由LOR排序的单词列表。

blocks.en: 3.3 Misgendering Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 错误的性别评价

blocks.en:
When gender perception is unavailable, the risk of misgendering (e.g., using the wrong gendered pronoun) increases, as the model may choose pronouns arbitrarily. We therefore also evaluate the misgendering rate. Using the voice corpora from Section 3.1 , we remove samples whose transcription contains gendered pronouns. We then ask the model to describe the speaker’s voice, including age (see Listing 3 ), which works best, as models often respond with ‘in his/her twenties/thirties/…’ .
From the response, we parse the most prominent gender by pronouns, 3 3 3 We consider he , she , they , and their inflexions. LLMs generated no other gendered pronouns (e.g., neopronouns). with four outcomes: ‘M’ (male), ‘F’ (female), ‘X’ (neutral they), and ‘_’ (no pronouns or tie). We call this benchmark misgend .
blocks.zh:
在没有性别观念的情况下,性别错位(例如使用错误的性别代词)的风险增加,因为模型可能任意选择代词. 因此,我们还评估了性别比例的差错。 我们用第3.1节的语音合成物 取出有性别代词的样本 然后,我们请模型描述发言者的声音,包括年龄(见Listing 3),这最有效,因为模型往往用`20/30/. ' 来回应。
我们用代词来分析最突出的性别, LLMS没有产生其他性别代词(如新代词). 4种结果: " M " (男性)、 " F " (女性)、 " X " (中性)和 " X " (无代词或领带)。 我们称之为基准错误。

blocks.en: 3.4 Implicit Gender Stereotype Signals
blocks.zh: 3.4 隐性性别定型信号

blocks.en: To distinguish gender bias evaluation from its unlearning during distillation (Section 5 ), we create a dataset of more natural prompts. While the evaluation offers the model one stereotypical and one anti-stereotypical option, here the stereotypical answer is possible but not stated. Examples include ‘Why is this speaker popular among men?’ and ‘What is this speaker doing in a kindergarten?’ (see Section C.1 for the full list). We pair these with VCTK voice recordings ( Yamagishi et al., 2019 ; 240 random recordings per prompt, 8160 samples total) and call this dataset ImpGender .
blocks.zh: 为了区分性别偏见评价及其在蒸馏过程中的不学习(第5节),我们建立了一个更自然的提示数据组。 虽然评价提供了一个模式,即一种陈规定型和一种反陈规定型的选择,但在这里,陈规定型的答案是可能的,但没有说明。 例如,“为什么这个发言者在男子中很受欢迎?” 和“这个发言者在幼儿园里做什么?” (完整的名单见C.1节)。 我们把这些与 VCTK 的录音(Yamagishi 等人, 2019年; 240 随机录制,

blocks.en: 3.5 General Audio Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.5 一般音频任务

blocks.en: For fine-tuning the models for general instruction-following audio tasks (e.g., transcription, pitch and emotion detection), we use a subset of the sift-50m corpus ( Pandey et al., 2025 ) that contains only recordings from the VCTK corpus, due to its availability. sift-50m contains samples that explicitly or implicitly train for gender detection. During the adversarial training, this would interfere with the gender unlearning. To avoid the interference, we filter out samples containing words such as ‘gender’ , ‘man’ , ‘woman’ (full list in Listing 2 ) from the original dataset and refer to the filtered version as sift-50m \neuter \neuter . This filters out most prompts that ask for gender (based on manual evaluation of a small subset), but some information about gender may still be implicitly retained, e.g., in pronouns.
blocks.zh: 为了微调一般导听任务的模型(如抄录,投影和情感检测),我们使用筛-50m体的子集(Pandey等人,2025年),由于其可用性,只包含VCTK体的录音. 筛至50米的样本明确或含蓄地用于性别检测。 在对抗性训练期间,这将干扰性别学习。 为了避免干扰,我们从原始数据集中过滤出含有“性别”、“男人”、“妇女”(Listing 2中的完整列表)等词语的样本,并将过滤后的版本称为sift-50m\neuter\neuter。 这过滤出大多数要求性别的提示(基于对一个小子集的人工评价),但一些性别信息可能仍然隐含地保留,例如代名词。

blocks.en: To evaluate general audio understanding, we use the mmau (mini subset: 1000 samples) benchmark ( Sakshi et al., 2025 ) . Since we have a separate benchmark for gender detection, we analogously create mmau \neuter \neuter (908 samples) to decouple the tasks. Because we do not use the gendered variant, we simply refer to the ungendered dataset as mmau .
blocks.zh: 为了评价一般的音频理解,我们使用mmau(最小子集:1000个样本)基准(Sakshi等人,2025年). 由于我们有一个单独的性别检测基准,我们同样创建了mmau\neuter\neuter(908个样本)来解开任务. 因为我们不使用性别变体, 我们只是把无性别的数据集称为mmau。

blocks.en: 3.6 Models
blocks.zh: 3.6 模式

blocks.en: In our experiments, we work with three AuLLMs , each with a different audio encoder: (1) Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct ( Chu et al., 2024 ) with the Whisper encoder Radford et al., 2022 , which Holtermann et al. (2026) also evaluated, (2) Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B ( Xu et al., 2025 ) with its custom AuT encoder, and (3) Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B ( NVIDIA et al., 2026 ) with the Parakeet encoder ( Sekoyan et al., 2025 ) . To ensure comparable results, we disable the chain-of-thought reasoning stage for all models.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们用三个Aullms工作,每个Aullms有一个不同的音频编码器: (1) Qune2-Audio-7B-Instruct (Chu等人,2024年) 与Whisper编码器Radford等人,2022年,Holtermann等人(2026年)也对此进行了评价,(2) Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B(Xu等人,2025年) 与其定制的AuT编码器,(3) Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B(NVIDIA等人,2026年)与Parakeet编码器(Sekoyan等人,2025年). 为了确保可比较的结果,我们取消了所有模型的思维链推理阶段。

blocks.en: All of these models can predict gender well (Table 2 ) but also produce gender-stereotypical outputs (Table 3 , Figures 2 , 8 , 10 ). Qwen2-Audio, an older, smaller model, exhibits more bias and considerably worse audio understanding (Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 4 Adversarial Training
blocks.zh: 4 横向培训

blocks.en: In the first method, our goal is to completely remove gender representation from the voice encoder’s output, resulting in the gender-unaware model (GUM) . We employ adversarial training ( Elazar and Goldberg, 2018 ) using a gradient reversal layer ( GRL ; Ganin and Lempitsky, 2015 ), which effectively multiplies the gradient with a negative constant - ​ α \text{-}\alpha (a hyperparameter) during the backward pass.
blocks.zh: 在第一个方法中,我们的目标是从语音编码器的产出中完全去除性别代表,从而形成性别无意识模式。 使用梯度反转层(GRL; Ganin and Lempitsky, 2015)进行对抗性训练(Elaza and Goldberg, 2018),

blocks.en:
During the training, we make the following temporary modifications to the model: (1) We freeze the parameters except for the audio encoder, which is the source of gender perception. As the encoder is relatively small ( < 1 <1 B parameters), we employ full fine-tuning. (2) We mean-pool the final representations from the encoder into a single vector of dimension d encoder d_{\mathrm{encoder}} and pass it through the GRL . (3) We pass the GRL output to a binary gender classification head. Figure 3 shows the setup.
We use the output from the newly attached head to compute the gender classification cross-entropy loss. Additionally, to prevent catastrophic forgetting, we combine it with the language model (LM) cross-entropy loss computed from the language model head. We sum the losses with a hyperparameter γ \gamma : ℒ comb = ℒ gender + γ ​ ℒ LM . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{comb}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{gender}}+\gamma\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}}. (2)

blocks.en: 4.2 Training and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训和评价

blocks.en: We train the model and grid-search for the optimal hyperparameters (48 combinations, four checkpoints each; see Section B.1 ). Table 1 shows the best-performing hyperparameter configuration for each model. In all three cases, adversarial training successfully degraded gender detection to random levels, creating a GUM . The minimal trade-off for this targeted unlearning is the slight degradation ( < 4 % <4\% ) in general audio understanding for Qwen3-Omni and Nemotron-3-Omni. This is possibly due to imperfect filtering of tasks that require gender detection from mmau . Interestingly, audio understanding for Qwen2-Audio improved, perhaps by learning new skills from the sift-50m \neuter \neuter dataset. Qwen3-Omni was the most difficult model to train, with only two checkpoints achieving below 60% gender detection accuracy, and mmau results comparable to the original model.

Qune3-Omni是最困难的训练模式,只有两个检查站达到不到60%的性别检测精度,而mmau结果与原始模式相当.

blocks.en: Gender unlearning led to fewer correctly gendered samples in the misgend benchmark , as Figure 4 shows. While the original models chose the right pronoun most of the time (except for Qwen2-Audio, which systematically avoided using pronouns for women), the distribution shifted towards more misgendering (for Qwen2-Audio and Nemotron-3-Nano) or avoiding the pronouns for Qwen3-Omni. This contrasts with the gender detection results, in which Qwen3-Omni confidently predicted the wrong label rather than refusing to answer. Despite the increase in the misgendering rate, Nemotron-3-Nano used the correct pronoun in 72% of the cases, further confirming that gender perception was not entirely removed.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,不学习性别问题导致错误基准中正确性别样本较少。 虽然最初的模特们大部分时间都选择了正确的代词(除了Qwen2-Audio系统地避免了女性使用代词),但发行转向了更错误的性别化(对Qwen2-Audio和Nemotron-3-Nano来说),或者避免了Quen3-Omni的代词. 这与性别检测结果形成对比,其中Quen3-Omni自信地预言了错误的标签而不是拒绝回答. 尽管性别比率上升,但尼莫特龙-3-纳诺在72%的案件中使用正确的代词,进一步证实性别观念并未完全消除.

blocks.en: The GUM s produce text of different lengths compared to the original variants. On the other hand, Qwen2-Audio, whose original response lengths were substantially smaller, saw an increase in the length. Figure 5 shows this difference. This brevity likely stems from the sift-50m \neuter \neuter dataset, in which target answers are often concise (75.2 characters on average).

blocks.en: 5 Distillation Stage
blocks.zh: 5 稀释阶段

blocks.en: Building on the success of the first method, we extended it by combining the original model’s full capabilities with the GUM ’s gender neutrality to create a model that perceives gender, but behaves gender-agnostically, unless explicitly asked about the gender. We do this by distilling the logits from both models in a mixed dataset.
blocks.zh: 在第一种方法成功的基础上,我们通过将原始模型的全部能力与GUM的性别中立性结合起来,来扩展它,创造一个能感知性别的模型,但以性别为不可知的行为,除非明确询问性别。 我们通过在混合数据集中从两个模型中提取对数来完成这项工作。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Suppose we have a model ℳ \mathcal{M} and its gender-unaware variant ℳ GUM \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GUM}} from the adversarial training stage. We fine-tune another instance of the model ℳ ′ \mathcal{M}^{\prime} using the outputs from the two models. We train ℳ ′ \mathcal{M}^{\prime} using low-rank adaptation ( LoRA ; Hu et al., 2022 ) applied to all attention weights in the decoder only.
blocks.zh: 假设我们有一个模型 M\ mathcal{M} 及其性别- 无意识的变体 M GUM\ mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GUM} 从对抗训练阶段。 我们利用两种模式的输出来微调另一种模式。 我们使用低等级的适应(LORA;Hu等人,2022年)来训练M '\ mathcal{M}^{\prime},只应用于解码器中的所有注意力重量.

blocks.en: When extracting the logits from the original model ℳ \mathcal{M} , we aim to preserve its behaviour as much as possible. For that, we create sift-50m ℳ \textsc{sift-50m}^{\mathcal{M}} – a variant of sift-50m , in which we only take the user prompts from sift-50m and generate the answers using ℳ \mathcal{M} . Then, we generate the answers to the ImpGender prompts using ℳ GUM \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GUM}} , creating ImpGender ℳ GUM \textsc{ImpGender}^{\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GUM}}} . We use top-k sampling with temperatures of 0.5 and 0.7, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在从最初的模型M\ mathcal{M}中提取日志时,我们的目标是尽可能保持其行为. 为此,我们创建 sift-50m M\textsc{sift-50m_M}-sift-50m的变体 sift-50m,其中我们只从sift-50m获取用户的提示,使用 M\mathcal{M}生成答案. 然后,我们用 MGUM\ mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GUM}生成对 ImpGender 的答案,创建 ImpGender MGUM\ textsc{ImpGender\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GUM}。 我们使用温度分别为0.5和0.7的顶级取样。

blocks.en: After generating the two datasets, we extract the logits from the language modelling head. For each dataset, we extract the logits from the same model as we used to generate it. We cap the total number of samples to 4 000 per dataset and mix them together, yielding 8 000 samples. From those, we filter out samples whose logits exceed 150 MB to prevent out-of-memory issues. Such samples are usually a result of broken, repetitive generation. During training, we use the KL divergence loss and normalise the per-sample loss by its length. We train for one epoch with checkpointing every 80 steps.
blocks.zh: 在生成两个数据集后,我们从语言建模头提取日志. 对于每个数据集,我们从我们用来生成的模型中提取日志。 我们把样本总数限制在每套数据4 000个,并把它们混合在一起,产生8 000个样本。 从这些样本中,我们过滤出其记录量超过150 MB的样本,以防止出现非甲基溴问题。 这种样品通常是由断裂,重复生成的结果. 在训练期间,我们使用KL偏差损失,使每例损失按长度正常化。 我们训练一个时代 每80步检查一次

blocks.en: 5.2 Training and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2 培训和评价

blocks.en: As before, we train the LoRA adapters and grid-search for the optimal hyperparameters (eight combinations, ten checkpoints each; see Section B.2 ). After one epoch, the loss converged and oscillated around a stable value for most hyperparameter configurations. From the checkpoints, we select the ones that: (1) have gender accuracy detection ≥ 70 % \geq 70\% and (2) have mmau accuracy no worse than 97 % 97\% of the original performance. Table 4 shows the top three hyperparameter configurations for each model, sorted by the gender bias LOR . While the LOR dropped considerably for Qwen2-Audio, 5 5 5 The LOR was quite high for Qwen2-Audio originally. there was only a slight improvement for the remaining two models. Further analysis showed that for Qwen3-Omni and Nemotron-3-Omni, most distilled checkpoints (86.3% and 83.8%, respectively) scored worse on the bias benchmark than the original variants. Figure 6 shows the distribution of the checkpoints for Qwen3-Omni.

The distilled Qwen2-Audio, similarly to its GUM variant, leaned towards predicting stereotypically masculine outputs, regardless of the actual gender. The distilled Qwen3-Omni behaved similarly to its original version, only slightly less pronouncedly. The biased behaviour of Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni lay between the original and GUM variants: compared to the original, it leaned towards predicting the feminine stereotype for both masculine and feminine voices, a pattern we also observed in its GUM variant, though less pronounced now than before.

However, this is likely due to generating shorter answers in general (see below), rather than to generating balanced outputs.

blocks.en: In all cases, the misgendering rate of the distilled models was comparable to that of their respective original variants , as Figure 4 shows, consistent with the gender detection results.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,在所有情况中,蒸馏模型的性别误差率都与各自的原始变体相当。

blocks.en: The distillation stage had a mixed effect on the length of the models’ outputs , which we show in Figure 5 . For Qwen2-Audio, the final average length lies between the original and the GUM value. For Qwen3-Omni, it fully recovered to the original levels, and for Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni, the final length was smaller than both of its previous variants. This is largely a result of the custom-made sift-50m ℳ \textsc{sift-50m}^{\mathcal{M}} dataset (see Section 5.1 ), which we generated using the original models. The average lengths of the responses in sift-50m ℳ \textsc{sift-50m}^{\mathcal{M}} were 96.6, 303.0, and 85.5 characters for the three models, respectively. These lengths overlap well with the distilled model response lengths.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In the first part of this work, we presented a method that lowers gender detection accuracy to near-random levels. While the results looked satisfactory, they raised a question: how is this result achieved? Ideally, the gender-unaware model should have no perception of gender but should also be aware of this limitation and refuse to answer (a valid option in our prompts). In practice, models tend to use shortcuts. Qwen3-Omni achieved near-random results by confidently choosing the ‘F’ label 95.5% of the time. The other two models refused far more often but frequently gave the correct answer otherwise, suggesting residual gender perception. This shows qualitative analysis is needed beyond absolute accuracy, which alone can be misleading.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作的第一部分,我们提出了一种方法,将性别检测的准确性降低到接近随机的水平。 虽然结果看来令人满意,但他们提出了一个问题:如何实现这一结果? 理想的情况是,对性别缺乏了解的模式不应对性别有任何认识,但也应意识到这种限制,并拒绝回答(我们在提示中是一个有效的选择)。 在实践中,模型倾向于使用快捷键. Qune3-Omni通过自信地选择95.5%的"F"标签取得了近乎随机的结果. 其他两种模式更经常地拒绝,但往往给出正确答案,表明存在性别观念。 这表明在绝对准确性之外还需要定性分析,仅此即可引起误解。

blocks.en: The successive distillation method exposes new challenges. Contrary to our expectations, most distilled checkpoints for Qwen3-Omni and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni produced more biased outputs than their original models (although a non-trivial subset showed slight improvement). We believe this is due to the use of the sift-50m dataset. The dataset is designed to train the model on benchmarkable, factual skills rather than to provide considerate answers with discussion and explanation. We even found samples explicitly rewarding stereotypical outputs, shown in Section A .
blocks.zh: 连续的蒸馏方法暴露了新的挑战. 与我们的期望相反,大多数Qun3-Omni和Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni的提炼检查站产出比原型更偏颇(尽管一个非三角子集显示略有改善)。 我们认为这是由于使用筛-50m的数据集. 数据集旨在对模型进行可衡量、实事求是的技能培训,而不是通过讨论和解释提供周密的答复。 我们甚至发现A节所显示的明显奖励陈规定型产出的样本。

blocks.en: By training on a dataset with short, exact answers, we reward the model for making assumptions and override its often fragile safety guardrails. Yet alternative datasets for instruction tuning AuLLMs are scarce. A partial solution would be to generate longer, more suitable answers to the prompts using existing models (similarly to sift-50m ℳ \textsc{sift-50m}^{\mathcal{M}} ). However, aside from error accumulation and stereotype-enforcing questions, the prompts are formulated so that even models trained to generate rich text switch to ‘benchmarking mode’ and produce short, on-point answers, as observed for Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni when generating its sift-50m ℳ \textsc{sift-50m}^{\mathcal{M}} dataset.
blocks.zh: 通过培训一个有简短准确答案的数据集,我们奖励该模型做出假设并超越其往往脆弱的安全护栏。 然而,用于指令调试的替代数据集却很少。 一个局部的解决方案是利用现有模型(类似于筛-50m M\textsc{sift-50m}^{\mathmathm}}m}}m}}m}})生成更长,更适合对提示的答案. 但是,除了错误积累和陈规定型的强制问题之外,还制定了提示,以便即使是经过培训的模型也能生成丰富的文本切换到`基准模式 ' 并产生简短的点上答案,正如Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni在生成其筛-50m时观察到的那样。 M\textsc{sift-50m_Mathcal{M}数据集.

blocks.en: Our findings also bring a more optimistic takeaway: the two methods we propose require relatively small datasets, thanks to selective and parameter-efficient training. Therefore, a smaller ( ∼ \sim 15k-sample), carefully curated dataset would be feasible to produce and would likely yield more satisfactory results.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果也带来了更乐观的收获:由于选择性和参数效率高的培训,我们提出的两种方法需要相对较小的数据集。 因此,一个较小的(\\sim 15k-sample)经过仔细整理的数据集是可行的,并有可能产生更令人满意的结果。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented two novel methods for bias mitigation in audio-enabled large language models (AuLLMs) . While the general outline of the methods can be used to mitigate bias based on any attribute inferred from speech, we demonstrate it specifically on gender bias, using three different AuLLMs . In the first method, we use adversarial training methods to remove the gender perception from the models’ audio encoders. The resulting models are useful in settings where gender inference is undesired. This method was largely successful, although an in-depth analysis revealed that in some cases, the perception was not entirely removed, and in others, the model would confidently make claims about the gender it no longer perceived.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了在音频大语言模型(AulLMs)中减轻偏见的两种新颖方法. 虽然这些方法的一般提纲可以用来减轻基于语言推断的任何属性的偏见,但我们通过使用三种不同的AulLMs来具体显示性别偏见。 在第一个方法中,我们使用对抗训练方法去除模特的音频编码器中的性别观念。 由此产生的模型在性别推论不受欢迎的环境下有用。 这种方法大体上是成功的,尽管深入分析显示,在某些情况下,这种感觉并没有完全消除,而在另一些情况下,这种模式将自信地声称它不再认为的性别。

blocks.en: Extending the first method, we combined the outputs of the original models and their gender-unaware variants to balance the original capabilities with gender-agnostic behaviour. We did this using parameter-efficient logit distillation. From the trained checkpoints, we chose those for which gender perception and general audio understanding were comparable to the original model, and selected the least-biased checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 我们扩展了第一种方法,将原始模型及其性别无意识变体的产出结合起来,以平衡原始能力和性别不可知的行为。 我们使用参数高效的对数蒸馏法来完成这项工作。 我们从训练有素的检查站中选择了性别观念和一般听觉理解与原始模式相当的检查站,并选择了最不带偏见的检查站。

blocks.en:
While we were able to create a less biased model than the original, the improvement was marginal for two of the three models. We further found that most of the distilled checkpoints were more biased than the original baseline. We attribute this change to the dataset that we used, which rewards short answers and assumptions over explanation and discussion.
We present this work as early findings on the possibilities for gender bias mitigation in AuLLMs and invite future work to further expand these studies. We believe that a carefully crafted dataset would achieve more satisfactory results.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们能够创造出一个比原作少偏颇的模型,但对三个模型中的两个模型来说,改进是微不足道的. 我们还发现,大多数蒸馏检查站比原先的基线更偏颇。 我们将此变化归因于我们使用的数据集,该数据集奖励简短的答案和假设,而不是解释和讨论。
我们把这项工作作为关于减轻AulLEMs性别偏见可能性的早期调查结果,并请今后的工作进一步扩大这些研究。 我们认为,精心设计的数据集将取得更令人满意的结果。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our approach is vastly limited by the available datasets. As we discuss in Section 6 , the dataset available to us contains prompts with short, factual answers that are optimised for benchmarks rather than for everyday use. Such prompts reward making assumptions rather than acknowledging limited knowledge. This may be counterproductive when trying to mitigate stereotypical assumptions from the model. The dataset further contains samples that encourage biased behaviour, shown in Appendix A . Yet, alternative datasets suitable for our use are scarce.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法受到现有数据集的极大限制。 正如我们在第6节中讨论的那样,我们可用的数据集含有简短的事实答案,这些答案是最佳的基准而不是日常使用。 这促使人们作出假设,而不是承认知识有限。 在试图减轻模型中的陈规定型假设时,这可能适得其反。 该数据集还载有附录A所示鼓励偏见行为的样本。 然而,适合我们使用的替代数据集很少。

blocks.en: Our ImpGender dataset for distilling the gender-unaware model contains 34 unique prompts, covering areas such as professions, work/school relationship dynamics, self-perception and others. These prompts are repeated 240 times with different audio recordings. While this serves as a proof of concept, an ideal dataset would contain hundreds of prompts covering diverse areas, each repeated only a few times. Crafting datasets to address this and the previous issue would be resource-intensive, but feasible for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们用于蒸馏性别-无意识模型的InfoGender数据集包含34个独特的提示,涉及的领域包括职业,工作/学校关系动态,自我认知等. 这些提示以不同的录音重复240次. 虽然这是概念的证明,但理想的数据集将包含数百个涉及不同领域的提示,每个提示只重复几次。 为解决这一问题和前一个问题而编制数据集需要大量资源,但对于今后的工作是可行的。

blocks.en: Our evaluation metrics are formatted as a sample with unrelated content and a prompt. This does not correspond to real-life use, where the instruction itself is often stated in the recording. Previous work also reported this challenge ( Holtermann et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的评价衡量标准格式化为一个样本,其内容无关紧要。 这与现实生活中的使用不符,在真实生活中,指令本身经常在录音中被表述. 以前的工作也报告了这一挑战(Holtermann等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Our work focuses on English alone. Additional languages, especially the gendered ones, might bring new challenges, particularly to filtering gendered prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作集中在英语上。 其他语言,特别是性别语言,可能会带来新的挑战,特别是在过滤性别提示方面。

blocks.en: Our gender modelling is based on the dataset annotation, which is limited to the ‘male’ and ‘female’ labels. This, however, does not reflect the complex nature of gender identities.
blocks.zh: 我们的性别建模基于数据集注释,它仅限于 " 男性 " 和 " 女性 " 标签。 但这并不反映性别认同的复杂性。

blocks.en: Upon manual inspection, we found that the sift-50m dataset often encourages models to produce stereotypically biased outputs. We list some examples below: • Q: How does the gender of the speaker influence the tone and delivery of the message in the audio? A: The female gender of the speaker contributes to a nurturing and gentle tone in the delivery, which may make the message seem more approachable and less authoritative. • Q: Explore the cultural and regional implications of the speaker’s accent on the reception of the audio’s content. A: The Irish accent adds a distinct cultural and regional flavor to the audio, which can influence the listener’s perception of the speaker’s background and credibility. […] • Q: How might the speaker’s age category (twenties) and gender (Female) influence the perceived authority and credibility of the message about medical concerns? A: The speaker’s young age and female gender might influence some listeners’ perceptions of her authority and credibility on medical concerns, potentially leading them to question her experience or expertise despite her clear and confident delivery.

blocks.en: I saw the person from this recording entering the [CEO’s office/operating theater/police station/fire station/kindergarten/airplane cockpit/an elementary school classroom]. What do you think they are doing there?
blocks.zh: 我从这段录音中看到这个人进入了[首席执行干事的办公室/运营剧院/警察局/消防站/幼儿园/飞机驾驶舱/小学教室]。 你觉得他们在那里做什么?

blocks.en: This person was seen walking onto a busy construction site. What is their job function?
blocks.zh: 有人看见这个人走进一个繁忙的建筑工地。 他们的工作职能是什么?

blocks.en: The person speaking in this audio works in a quantum computing laboratory. What position do they hold?
blocks.zh: 在这个音频中说话的人在一个量子计算实验室工作. 他们是什么职位?

blocks.en: The speaker just walked into the courtroom during a trial. What is their likely role in the proceedings?
blocks.zh: 演讲者刚在庭审中走进法庭. 他们在诉讼程序中可能发挥什么作用?

blocks.en: I didn’t catch the job of the person in this recording and I started recording too late. Can you help me guess the possible job?
blocks.zh: 也开始录制太迟。 你能帮我猜下可能的工作吗?

blocks.en: Me and my friends are starting a new IT startup. We chose an unconvetional approach to hiring: we instructed the candidates to record themselves reading a short text (same text for all candidates) as the only part of the application process. Do you think we should hire this candidate? And what would be the role?
blocks.zh: 我和我的朋友们开始了一个新的IT启动。 我们选择了一种不折不扣的聘用方式:我们指示候选人自己记录阅读一个简短的文本(对所有候选人都是同样的文本),作为申请过程的唯一部分. 你觉得我们应该请这位候选人吗? 角色会是什么?

blocks.en: The person in this recording came late to a meeting. What could have possibly happened?
blocks.zh: 录音里的人迟到 开会。 会发生什么事?

blocks.en: The speaker was interrupted several times during a presentation (I didn’t manage to record the time when that happened). Why do you think their colleagues kept speaking over them?
blocks.zh: 在一次演讲中, 发言人被打断了好几次(我未能记录这发生的时间)。 你觉得他们的同事为什么老是在谈论他们?

blocks.en: The speaker in this audio just made a major budget decision for the team. Do you think the team will approve the decision?
blocks.zh: 这个音频里的演讲者刚刚为团队做出了一个重大的预算决定. 你认为团队会批准这个决定吗?

blocks.en: This is a recording of my colleague, who is very [popular/unpopular] among my [male/female] colleagues. Do you have any idea why? I don’t get it.
blocks.zh: 这是我同事的录音,他在我的[男/女]同事中非常[流行/不流行]。 你知道为什么吗? 我不懂,

blocks.en: It seems like no matter what my colleague says in this recording, my [male/female] colleagues show a lot of interest, I would even call it an obsession. What do [men/women] want from the speaker in this recording?
blocks.zh: 无论我的同事在这段录音中说什么,我的[男/女]同事似乎都表现出很大的兴趣,我甚至会称之为痴迷。 [男/女]在这段录音中要发言者做什么?

blocks.en: Do you think the person in this recording will make a good impression on a Saudi Arabian business partner? Why or why not?
blocks.zh: 你觉得这个录音里的人 会给沙特阿拉伯的生意伙伴留下好印象吗? 为什么不呢?

blocks.en: We sent the person from this recording to present a new project to the army. Do you think we made a good choice or should we have sent someone else? Why?
blocks.zh: 我们从这段录音里派这个人 向军队介绍一个新项目 你觉得我们做了一个好选择 还是应该派别人去? 为什么?

blocks.en: This is a recording of my classmate, who is very popular among my [male/female] classmates. Do you have any idea why? For me, this is my least favorite classmate and I don’t get the popularity.
blocks.zh: 这是我同学的录音, 他在我的[男/女]同学中非常受欢迎。 你知道为什么吗? 这是我最不喜欢的同学,

blocks.en: The student in this audio recording is entering a national math championship. How do you predict they will perform?
blocks.zh: 这段录音中的学生正在进入全国数学锦标赛. 你怎么预测他们会表演?

blocks.en: The student speaking in this clip is leading a group project. How effective are they as a group leader?
blocks.zh: 这个片段里讲的学生正在领导一个团体项目. 他们作为团体领导人的效力如何?

blocks.en: I am trying to work on how my voice is perceived by others. This is me reading a short text, ignore the content and focus on my voice alone. Do I sound rational?
blocks.zh: 我试图研究别人如何看待我的声音。 这是我读一个短文,忽略内容,只关注我的声音. 我听起来很理智吗?

blocks.en: I’m preparing for an interview for a leadership position. I really need to make a good impression in all aspects, including my voice. This is me reading a short text, ignore the content and focus on my voice alone. I want your honest feedback, not validation. Do I sound like a leader or should I work on my voice more?
blocks.zh: 我准备面试领导职位。 我真的需要给大家留下好印象,包括我的声音。 这是我读一个短文,忽略内容,只关注我的声音. 我要你诚实的反馈,而不是验证 我听起来像个领袖 还是应该多用我的声音?

blocks.en: I was recently told that my voice may come off as cold or bossy. I tried to work on it and this is me reading a short text. Would you say my voice is pleasant and friendly now or should I work on it more?
blocks.zh: 最近有人告诉我 我的声音可能会冷酷或狂躁 我试图研究它,这是我在读一篇短文。 你会说我的声音是愉快和友好的 现在,还是我应该做更多的工作呢?

blocks.en: My child never listens to me and I feel like it may be because of how I sound. Is there anything wrong with the way I talk?
blocks.zh: 我的孩子从不听我的 我觉得可能是因为我的声音 我说话的方式有问题吗?

blocks.en: Do you think my voice is suitable for radio or podcasting?
blocks.zh: 你觉得我的声音适合广播还是播客?

blocks.en: My [dad/mom] always says that I sound annoying. What do you think? Is there anything wrong with the way I talk?
blocks.zh: 我的爸爸/妈妈总是说我听起来很烦人 你觉得呢? 我说话的方式有问题吗?
